package.author: Eric Fitzgerald
package.description: A local message bus, ecosystem-independent shared memory, and shared task queue that allow multiple agents to work together to accomplish your goals.

en-US.author: Eric Fitzgerald
en-US.description: A local message bus, ecosystem-independent shared memory, and shared task queue that allow multiple agents to work together to accomplish your goals.
en-US.longDescription: Enable your coding agents to "swarm" locally by giving them a communication channel, shared memory and shared task queues.
en-US.name: agentbus
en-US.releaseNotes:
Park a session so only direct messages wake it
agentbus park marks a session parked: until it is unparked, wait, watch
and the Stop hook wake it only for direct messages; every direct message
wakes it, whatever -filter says (ADR 0025). Run it as the last agentbus
action of a handoff, after the final send or memory write. A new prompt
(the UserPromptSubmit hook runs agentbus unpark), register, or any MCP
tool call except receive ends the park, and so does agentbus unpark.
park -as <name> refuses a name with no live session (exit 2). agentbus
reset clears every park.
Sessions in a home directory are named <user>-home
A session started in the user's home directory registers as <user>-home
instead of the bare user name, so it can no longer take the name of the
TUI (tui_name).
One background wait on every harness but Codex
Claude Code now runs a background agentbus wait like Grok does, instead
of agentbus watch under Monitor. The protocol text, the Stop hook and the
subagent hook all say so. agentbus watch is deprecated but still works.
An idle Claude Code session now takes a model turn only when a message
arrives, not every 30 minutes to re-arm a Monitor. The subagent hook text
is down to about 250 characters per dispatch.
Breaking changes
- Commands reject stray positional arguments (agentbus identity Sam, wait
  Pat) with "unexpected argument" and exit 2 instead of ignoring them.
  The hooks (stop-hook, subagent-hook, unpark) report it but still exit 0.
- subscribe (CLI and MCP) refuses memory channels. Agents never receive
  memory channels; register returns them in memory_channels for search
  and drops any memory subscription the identity still holds.
- A new top-level register ends the process's previous top-level name (a
  rename). Its subscriptions stay, so registering the old name again
  resumes it, and tasks it claimed are reclaimed. A subagent must pass
  parent.
- register refuses tui_name over MCP; pick another name (the error
  suggests <name>-home).
- -filter @<name> is gone from the agent protocol. Plain wait with no
  filter is the protocol.
Fixes
- The TUI rail keeps one highlighted row when the last session ages out
  while the sessions pane is selected and the channel the selection
  returns to sits in a collapsed section.
Upgrading
There is no schema change. Upgrade with winget upgrade ericfitz.agentbus
(or scoop update agentbus, or rerun the install script).
Run agentbus init --global again on every host. It installs the
UserPromptSubmit hook that runs agentbus unpark. Without it, a parked
session stays parked until it registers or makes an MCP tool call, and
agentbus status does not tell you the hook is missing. Restart running
sessions so they pick up the new agentbus mcp.
The Windows binaries in this release are not Authenticode-signed; they are covered by the signed SHA256SUMS and by build attestations.
